Subject: Clarification on the Expense Reimbursement Process

Dear Team,

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing to provide a clear overview of our current expense reimbursement process and to invite any questions you may have. This is an essential procedure that helps us maintain our financial records and ensure compliance with our policies.

To claim reimbursement, please follow these steps:

1. Record all your expenses using the company-provided expense report form. Ensure you provide a detailed description and attach relevant receipts or invoices.
2. Submit the completed form along with supporting documents to the finance department by the last working day of each month.
3. Our finance team will review your expenses and process the reimbursement within two weeks from the submission date.

For any queries or further information, please feel free to reach out to me or any member of the finance team. Your prompt
